# poke

**Goal:** land runs sooner when work waits for it. Poking saves waiting, never attempts. Land sends the Machine's commands itself (`BeginLanding`, `CompleteLanding`, `HoldLanding`, `RecordChecks`, `ReportOutside`, `RecordPr`, `VoidReview`); no session does.

Start land only when all of these hold:
- `cooknship show`'s `board.available` has `land` or `checks` above 0, or `landing` above 0 and a merged landing pull request woke you;
- the latest land run, if any, is `completed` (find it with `gh run list -R alebairos/sheet-exp-host --workflow cooknship-land --limit 1 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,startedAt,url`, and its `land:` lines with `gh run view <databaseId> -R alebairos/sheet-exp-host --log | grep -F 'land: '`);
- if there is one, it succeeded. A run that did not (failure, cancelled, timed out, any other) goes to the human once, with its link and its last `land:` lines (or its error), unless its link is already in the human's channel (*humans decide what and whether, and their attention is the scarcest resource*: a failure costs it once). Never start such a run again yourself;
- an event woke you (your own review passing counts), or there is no run, or it started 20 minutes ago or more.

Then, once: `gh workflow run cooknship-land -R alebairos/sheet-exp-host`.

**Done:** land started (or asked for) once and you printed which, or a condition failed and you stopped.
